Souha Bus sound effects - all CC0 (public domain), free for personal and commercial use.
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Kenney "Interface Sounds" (www.kenney.nl)
  board.mp3         <- pluck_001.ogg
  bus-full.mp3      <- confirmation_002.ogg
  select.mp3        <- select_002.ogg
  buy.mp3           <- confirmation_004.ogg
  station-open.mp3  <- maximize_008.ogg
  switch.mp3        <- switch_002.ogg
  error.mp3         <- error_004.ogg
  menu-open.mp3     <- open_002.ogg

Kenney "Casino Audio" (www.kenney.nl)
  coins.mp3         <- chips-stack-3.ogg

"Air Woosh Move" by Almitory, OpenGameArt.org (https://opengameart.org/content/air-woosh-move)
  depart.mp3        <- air_move.wav (trimmed to 1.2 s with a fade-out)

Converted to mono 96 kbps MP3 with leading silence trimmed.

Kenney "Music Jingles" (www.kenney.nl)
  arrival.mp3       <- jingles_STEEL10.ogg (steel drum, rising D-E-F#-G)

Special traveler sounds (all CC0, www.kenney.nl)
  vip.mp3           <- Casino Audio: chips-collide-2.ogg
  gift.mp3          <- Music Jingles: jingles_PIZZI10.ogg (rising D-E-F#-G)
  diamond.mp3       <- Interface Sounds: glass_002.ogg
  rush.mp3          <- Music Jingles: jingles_PIZZI02.ogg (rising run)
  heart.mp3         <- Interface Sounds: pluck_002.ogg
  combo.mp3         <- Interface Sounds: confirmation_001.ogg

More interface sounds (CC0, www.kenney.nl, Interface Sounds)
  tick.mp3          <- tick_002.ogg (claim countdown)
  lost.mp3          <- minimize_006.ogg (fare lost)
  note.mp3          <- Music Jingles: jingles_STEEL16.ogg (single steel-drum note, trimmed; played up a pentatonic scale as combos grow)

"pop sounds" by EZduzziteh, OpenGameArt.org (https://opengameart.org/content/pop-sounds-0) - CC0
  pop-a.mp3 <- pop9.wav, pop-b.mp3 <- pop4.wav, pop-c.mp3 <- pop1.wav (boarding pops, loudness-normalised)

Claim and purchase sounds (all CC0)
  ping.mp3          <- "plingy coin" by Fupi, OpenGameArt.org (https://opengameart.org/content/plingy-coin); played as a rising 5-note cascade
  coin-jingle.mp3   <- Kenney "RPG Audio": handleCoins.ogg (www.kenney.nl)
  purchase.mp3      <- "Purchasing Sound Effect" by Spring Spring, OpenGameArt.org (https://opengameart.org/content/purchasing-sound-effect), trimmed to 1 s

Music and level jingles (all CC0, public domain) - MintoDog's "Cozy Puzzle" set, OpenGameArt.org
(https://opengameart.org/content/for-puzzle-game-mintodogs-music)
  music-menu.mp3    <- "Cozy Puzzle Stage Select" (https://opengameart.org/content/cozy-puzzle-stage-select)
  music-play.mp3    <- "Cozy Puzzle In-Game 1" (https://opengameart.org/content/cozy-puzzle-in-game-1)
  win.mp3           <- "Cozy Puzzle Clear (Jingle)" (https://opengameart.org/content/cozy-puzzle-jingle-result)
  lose.mp3          <- "Cozy Puzzle Failure (Jingle)" (same page)
  Converted to mono MP3.
